lede: Wat Pa Poe accounts for 5 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1872–1891 CE (2 of 5 carry a date).
